title: Adhyaya 9: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 9.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 9.

verses.original: अन्योन्यस्याव्यभीचारो भवेदामरणान्तिकः । एष धर्मः समासेन ज्ञेयः स्त्रीपुंसयोः परः ॥
verses.transliteration: anyonyasyāvyabhīcāro bhavedāmaraṇāntikaḥ | eṣa dharmaḥ samāsena jñeyaḥ strīpuṁsayoḥ paraḥ ||
verses.translation: Mutual fidelity between husband and wife should endure until death; this should be known as the highest duty between man and woman in brief.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The foundational marital ideal: lifelong devotion, mutual honor, and unbreakable commitment.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Mutual fidelity between husband and wife should endure until death; this should be known as the highest duty between man and woman in brief.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 9: The foundational marital ideal: lifelong devotion, mutual honor, and unbreakable commitment.

verses.original: यथा वायुं समाश्रित्य वर्तन्ते सर्वजन्तवः । तथा गृहस्थमाश्रित्य वर्तन्ते सर्व आश्रमाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā vāyuṁ samāśritya vartante sarvajantavaḥ | tathā gṛhasthamāśritya vartante sarva āśramāḥ ||
verses.translation: Just as all living beings exist depending upon the air, so all other stages of life exist depending upon the householder (Grihastha).

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The householder is the pillar of the social fabric, supporting students, hermits, and monks.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Just as all living beings exist depending upon the air, so all other stages of life exist depending upon the householder (Grihastha).

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 9: The householder is the pillar of the social fabric, supporting students, hermits, and monks.
